description: This file defines pybind11 bindings for std::chrono types, enabling conversion between C++ chrono durations/time_points and Python datetime objects. It includes classes for casting durations and time points, handling system clock conversions, and thread-safe localtime retrieval.

classes.name: duration_caster
classes.description: A template class for casting std::chrono durations and time_points to Python datetime.timedelta objects.

classes.name: type_caster<std::chrono::system_clock::time_point>
classes.description: Specialized caster for converting system_clock time_points to Python datetime.datetime objects.

classes.name: type_caster<std::chrono::time_point<Clock, Duration>>
classes.description: Generic caster for other clock time_points, inheriting from duration_caster.

classes.name: type_caster<std::chrono::duration<Rep, Period>>
classes.description: Caster for std::chrono durations, inheriting from duration_caster.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a Python object and converts it to a C++ chrono duration or time_point.

methods.name: cast
methods.description: Converts a C++ chrono duration or time_point to a Python datetime or timedelta object.

methods.name: localtime_thread_safe
methods.description: Thread-safe wrapper for localtime, returning a std::tm pointer.
